meta.title: KRACKED_OS // Ghibli-LowPoly Navigation + Horizontal Particle Parallax
meta.purpose: Complete design + interaction template for the KrackedDevs creative bounty. Combines the uploaded ParentSelector / 360° navigation diagram with three horizontal-parallax particle brains and a strict Ghibli/Nausicaä low-poly sketch aesthetic.
meta.viewport_rule: Everything must stay inside the visible viewport on all devices. No horizontal or vertical overflow. No browser zoom. No mobile long-press popup.

art_direction.primary_style: Bold black sketch outlines with hand-drawn quality + low-poly 3D grease-brush/pencil surfaces (5% visible smooth polygon edges) + pen-marker outline shader + low-poly shadow + Ghibli 80s anime (Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind) inspiration

surface_treatment.boxes: Doodle-style hand-drawn black outline + slight lifted drop-shadow (as if resting on paper). On hover: 1–2 px push-in / pressed keyboard-key effect (translateY(1px) + reduced shadow).
surface_treatment.particles: Low-poly grease-pencil clusters with 5% soft edge, muted teal/blue gradient, gentle hand-drawn jitter.
surface_treatment.typography: Slightly uneven hand-lettered feel (or a rounded mono with subtle noise). Labels use marker-outline weight.

css_mandatory: html, body { width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; position: fixed; overscroll-behavior: none; }
meta viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover
touch-action: manipulation on all interactive elements
input, textarea { font-size: 16px !important; } /* prevents iOS auto-zoom */
-webkit-user-select: none; user-select: none; on non-input areas
-webkit-touch-callout: none; /* kills long-press popup on mobile */
wheel event: preventDefault when over the particle stage so page never scrolls
js_mandatory: On any input focus: ensure font-size >= 16px and no scale transform on body

three_particle_brains.layout: Horizontal row of three low-poly particle clusters (BUILD / LEARN / EARN). They stay fully inside the viewport.

parallax.binding: mouse wheel (mwheelup / mwheeldown) and trackpad vertical scroll
parallax.behavior: Horizontal parallax shift only. Each brain moves at a different depth speed (0.4×, 0.7×, 1.0×). No vertical page scroll is allowed.
parallax.implementation: Listen to wheel event on the stage container → update three CSS transforms or Three.js group positions on the X axis. Clamp so particles never leave the visible area.

three_particle_brains.visual: Low-poly grease-pencil particles, muted teal → soft blue gradient, 5% soft polygon edges, gentle hand-drawn jitter animation, bold black sketch silhouette around each cluster.

navigation_system.description: Exact interaction model from the uploaded diagram, restyled as neuromorphic + minified + floating, Ghibli-sketch aesthetic.

core_component.name: ParentSelector (floating neuromorphic dial)
core_component.appearance: Small circular neuromorphic button, minified, floating bottom-center or bottom-right. Soft extruded look (light top-left, shadow bottom-right) in muted teal. Bold black hand-drawn outline.
core_component.activation: Press / click + HOLD (minimum 180 ms). On mobile: long-press does NOT open the system context menu (touch-callout + preventDefault).
core_component.gesture_after_hold: Once held, a 360° rotation gesture is active. Clockwise or anti-clockwise drag / pointer movement rotates the selector. Release ends the gesture.

states.held: Pressed-in (translateY(2px) + tighter shadow) + rotation ring appears
states.rotating: Ring follows finger/mouse, haptic tick on every NavTabItem snap (if available)

data_model_from_diagram.NavTabItems_per_parent: NavTabItem-1 … NavTabItem-7 (or fewer). Each maps to a ChildPage.
data_model_from_diagram.DisplayName: Display{ParentItem}{NavTabItem}Name — updates live as the dial rotates

indicator_panel.left_side: Vertical INDICATOR listing ParentPage1 / ParentPage2 with ChildPage links (hand-drawn boxes, lifted shadow, push-in on hover)

layout_constraints.desktop: Full stage fits 100vw × 100vh. Header thin, three brains horizontal center, floating ParentSelector bottom, indicator left, telemetry right.
layout_constraints.mobile: Same single viewport. Brains scale down and stack slightly or stay horizontal with tighter parallax range. ParentSelector larger touch target (min 48×48 px). No elements ever leave the safe area (env(safe-area-inset-*)).
layout_constraints.no_overflow: All absolute/fixed children must be constrained with max-width/max-height and overflow: hidden on the root stage.

interaction_flow: 1. Page loads → three low-poly particle brains visible, horizontal, idle gentle jitter.
2. User scrolls mouse wheel → brains parallax horizontally at different depths (no page scroll).
3. User presses + holds the floating neuromorphic ParentSelector → rotation ring appears, button presses in.
4. While held, user rotates finger/mouse 360° → NavTabItems cycle, DisplayName updates, corresponding ParentPage / ChildPage content cross-fades or slides in.
5. Release → selector returns to raised state, current selection is locked.
6. Hover any doodle box → slight push-in (keyboard key) + lifted shadow reduces.
7. Tap any input field → no browser zoom (font-size 16 px rule).

js_skeleton_key_behaviors.disable_zoom_and_callout: Add the four gesture preventDefault listeners + touch-callout:none + font-size:16px on inputs.
js_skeleton_key_behaviors.wheel_parallax: stage.addEventListener('wheel', e => { e.preventDefault(); const dx = e.deltaY * 0.15; brains.forEach((b,i) => b.x += dx * depths[i]); clamp(); }, {passive:false});
js_skeleton_key_behaviors.hold_then_rotate: pointerdown → startHoldTimer(180). If still down after 180 ms → enterRotateMode(). pointermove while inRotateMode → calculate angle from center → update NavTabIndex with inertia. pointerup / pointercancel → exitRotateMode().
js_skeleton_key_behaviors.mobile_safe: Use pointer events (not touch events alone). Call e.preventDefault() on pointerdown when over the selector so the browser never shows the callout menu.

implementation_checklist: Add the exact viewport meta tag that disables user scaling
Three particle brains in a horizontal flex row, parallax on wheel only
Doodle boxes with lifted shadow + push-in hover
Muted teal / soft blue / cream palette only
Low-poly grease-pencil particle look + bold black sketch outlines
No auto-zoom on input focus (16 px rule)
Everything stays inside the viewport on every device
quick_start_prompt: Build a single full-viewport page for the KrackedDevs creative bounty using this exact JSON as the source of truth. Art style must be bold black hand-drawn sketch outlines + low-poly grease-pencil 3D (5% soft edges) + Ghibli/Nausicaä 80s anime muted teal & soft blue. Three particle brains sit horizontally and only move with mouse-wheel parallax (no page scroll). Navigation is a floating minified neuromorphic dial: press+hold then 360° rotate to change ParentPage / NavTabItem. All doodle boxes have lifted shadow and keyboard-key push-in on hover. Strictly disable browser zoom, mobile long-press callout, and any overflow outside the viewport. Mobile safe-area respected. Output clean HTML/CSS/JS or React + Three.js.
